title: Maximal quality, context and security harness
claim_boundary: Source-verified implementation only; higher evidence levels require the named open gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Generate lockfile and make deterministic CI green
open_gates: Install Rust 1.97.1, generate Cargo.lock and make compiler CI green.
assertions.permitted_claim: No lockfile or compiler-green claim is made.

open_gates: Compile and execute Rust unit, integration, property, metamorphic, CDC, fuzz and mutation suites.
assertions.permitted_claim: Network-free static gates and Rust test source exist; Rust test execution remains open.

open_gates: Run llvm-cov and enforce measured coverage above the declared threshold.
assertions.permitted_claim: Coverage automation is configured but no coverage result is claimed.

assertions.statement: Run cargo-deny/audit/semver/machete, CodeQL, Scorecard, zizmor, actionlint
open_gates: Install and execute cargo-deny, audit, vet, semver, public-api and other configured tools.
assertions.permitted_claim: Security and API assurance gates are pinned and configured; tool execution is not inferred.

assertions.statement: Add SSRF, secret leakage, parser bomb and resource exhaustion tests
open_gates: Compile and run SSRF, parser bomb and resource-exhaustion adversarial tests.
assertions.permitted_claim: Static authority, secret and hazard controls exist; complete adversarial runtime testing remains open.

assertions.statement: Produce machine-readable verification receipt on every release
open_gates: Generate compiler, coverage, live, external and release receipts at the corresponding evidence levels.
assertions.permitted_claim: Machine-readable static receipts are produced; higher evidence receipts are not fabricated.
